zh: 只有相邻且相同的字符才需要处理；把单词切成若干段“连续相同字符”，各段之间互不影响，可以分别计算。
长度为 L 的一段里能取出 floor(L/2) 对互不重叠的相邻字符，每对至少要改一个；而隔一个改一个、改成与两侧都不同的字母（26 个字母足够），恰好用 floor(L/2) 次，所以每段贡献 floor(L/2)。
对每个单词线性扫描，记住上一个字符和当前段长；字符变化时把“段长/2”加进答案并把段长重置为 1，相同时段长加一；扫完再加上最后一段的“段长/2”。按输入顺序输出各单词的答案。总字符数可达 10^7，需要快速读入。
en: Only equal adjacent characters matter; split the word into runs of identical consecutive characters, and the runs can be handled independently.

A run of length L contains floor(L/2) disjoint adjacent pairs and each pair needs at least one change; changing every other character to a letter different from both neighbours (26 letters are enough) uses exactly floor(L/2) changes, so each run contributes floor(L/2).

Scan each word once, remembering the previous character and the current run length; when the character changes add run/2 to the answer and reset the run to 1, otherwise grow the run; after the scan add the last run's run/2. Print the answers in input order. The total length can reach 10^7 characters, so read the input quickly.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Split each word into runs of equal consecutive characters; a run of length L contributes floor(L/2).

## Proof of correctness

Within each run, take disjoint pairs of adjacent characters; each pair needs at least one change, which gives the lower bound floor(L/2). Change every other character, choosing a letter different from both neighbours; 26 letters are enough, so the lower bound is achieved exactly without breaking the boundaries between runs. Add up the runs.

## Complexity

O(total number of characters) time, with O(1) extra state while scanning each word; the largest input is 10000104 bytes.
